name.text: CHEM_U03_L02_QZ Q01 - Ionic Bonding and Formula Units

questiontext.text:
MLA Standard: MLA.CHEM.BON.01; MLA.CHEM.BON.02

Stimulus:

IonsCharge balanceFormula unit
Ca2+ and Cl-+2 balances two -1 ionsCaCl2
Al3+ and O2-two +3 ions balance three -2 ionsAl2O3

Question: Which statement connects the model to the chemistry standard?

generalfeedback.text: Use the embedded stimulus first, then connect the evidence to the bonding, formula, property, or nomenclature rule.

answer.text: CaCl2 is neutral because calcium changes its charge from 2+ to 1+.
